services.name: Yacht Clubs
services.desc: We welcome Yacht & Cruise Clubs! Once availability has been confirmed for your specific date(s) one of our managers will call the fleet captain to discuss payment options as well as other pertinent information such as the club’s roster and the name, length, beam, draft and type of vessel (sport fish, express, aft cabin, sail) and electrical requirements of each boat. Then SMM will send the fleet captain a confirmation letter. Rosters may be emailed. The preferred method of payment for yacht clubs is to have each captain call individually and guarantee their slip with a credit card. However, if you prefer, we will accommodate any method of payment that your club desires. Yacht and Cruise
